overview.en:
Explore public repository architecture and ask grounded code questions.

Use public repository documentation to understand architecture and implementation context. Keep repository references attached to technical explanations.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
阅读公开仓库架构文档，查询有代码依据的技术问题。

利用公开仓库文档理解架构与实现背景，在技术解释中保留仓库依据。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。
